headline: US hybrid vehicle market share expands as conflict inflates gasoline prices
summary: Hybrid vehicles are capturing higher market share in the United States as elevated fuel costs driven by the Middle East war prompt consumers to opt for dual-fuel power over pure EVs.
why: Auto purchasing trends between hybrids and electric vehicles dictate supply chain orders for global automotive manufacturers.

impacts.name: US Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Surging gasoline prices shift vehicle demand dynamics toward hybrid automobile powertrains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
